desc: The STEWARD COLLECTION delivers benchrest precision and explosive on-target performance for anything that threatens your herd. Utilizing the Sierra Tipped VarmintKing (formerly Tipped BlitzKing), and backed by Barnes' uncompromising standards, the Steward Collection runs true and hits hard - just like the men and women who carry it. Every shot honors the stock you raise, the land you work, and the wild you protect. Designed for predator and varmint control, this ammo means business - because protecting what's yours takes more than fences.
